description: Pfingstegg is the small cable-car terrace on a rock spur east of Grindelwald, with the cable dropping toward the village and a dark glacial valley of rock and remnant ice behind it. It replaces an Eiger Trail viewpoint, because the north face from the valley is already a separate scene, and it is not First and not Bachalpsee. The Open-Meteo model is overcast and mild, with cloud cover near seven-tenths, a light breeze, and no precipitation, and the sun is below the horizon.
